facts.fact: An undated retained notice suspends online roof-ticket sales because restoration means normal access cannot be guaranteed; guide warns to check current availability without declaring the whole cathedral closed.
facts.excerpt: the sale of online tickets for access to the roofs is temporarily suspended as we cannot guarantee the regular usability of the site.

facts.fact: The same notice says other monumental areas remain available to buy online or at ticket office.
facts.excerpt: It remains possible to buy entrance tickets for all the other areas of the Monumental Complex both online and at the ticket office.

title: Palermo Cathedral — visitor arrangements and roof maintenance notice
notes: Undated roof-maintenance notice and several incompatible hours blocks coexist on this operator page. Do not claim a current total roof closure or publish one fixed timetable. Verify roof availability with operator before booking. Historical2020reopening not treated ascurrent.
